references.text: The preceding verses in the same passage establish the order of inheritance: first daughters, then brothers, then uncles, and finally the nearest relative
Elaboration on the law of inheritance regarding the daughters of Zelophehad, stipulating that women who inherit must marry within their own tribe
The right of redemption for the nearest relative (גֹּאֵל) to help a poor relative redeem property
Description of who is considered a close relative with the right to redeem: uncles, cousins, or other near kin
Boaz as the kinsman-redeemer (גֹּאֵל) and practical application of inheritance law where the nearest relative has first rights to the inheritance
Jeremiah buys a field from his cousin Hanamel according to the right of redemption, confirming relatives' rights to inheritance and property
